en: A color-printed panoramic view of a large hospital complex situated on gently sloping green fields with scattered houses in the foreground and forested hills and snow‑capped mountains in the distance. The main buildings are long, white multi‑story blocks in a row, with a few yellow‑brown buildings and a tall brick chimney rising among them. At the top left of the image, red text reads "Graz. Landeskrankenhaus." indicating the subject of the scene.
